notes.title: Thanks for your feedback!
notes.content:
We are receiving a lot of feedback about this new prologue and update, both from new players and from people who already knew [b]Ignited Steel[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42526365/d94f67199311a2f1c7629e2f61a37e30fdf9e87a.gif[/img]

Thanks to the info you are providing us, we have fixed a bug that didn't allow some players to open the game due to a bad interaction with discord, also some localization problems and others related to  rewards on in-game events.

Remember to [b]keep sending us this kind of information[/b], both in the prologue and in the base game, as it helps us to improve [b]Ignited Steel[/b]. You can do it both here and in the Steam forums, as well as in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/895vmPBsKx]discord[/url] [/b]or [b][url=https://twitter.com/meteorbyte_stu]twitter[/url][/b].

If you like [b]Ignited Steel: Prologue[/b], we recommend you to check out the main game, it has a [b]30% discount[/b] this week! [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550740/Ignited_Steel_Mech_Tactics/]Check it out here[/url][/b]

See you soon!

notes.title: Some fixes after the first weekend!
notes.content:
Today is the day!

Ignited Steel free update UPRISING now available on your Steam library if you already own the game!

If you don’t, take your chance and[b] save a 25%[/b] buying the game during this first week discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42526365/7296b5ec80a7b7b542e6d6d7f7cfb1bbbaf858d8.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550740/Ignited_Steel_Mech_Tactics/][b]Get the game here![/b][/url]

If you like the game please, tell a friend! Spread the word and let them know that you love Ignited Steel!

Don’t hesitate to contact us and share your feedback of the new content of Ignited Steel: Uprising!


We would also like to say thanks to all the feedback you are giving us, we have fixed some of thebugs you have been reporting.

[hr][/hr]
Hotfixes:

  - Fixed bug that prevented the game from booting up in some cases.
  - Added missing localized text strings.
  - Solved event reward that would let player mechs deal x100 damage.

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for your help, do not hesitate to keep sending us this kind of info!

See you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42526365/1c1776ccb957de830a9f0c1491e1f23a5cea99ee.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Ignited Steel: Prologue
notes.content:
[b]Ignited Steel: Prologue[/b] is a free trial version that expands the lore of the main game, which will receive an update on Monday, October 17th.

This prologue tells you the story of how the most advanced AI ever developed by humankind, Phar0s, turned against its own creators!

[b]If you've enjoyed the Prologue, check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550740/Ignited_Steel_Mech_Tactics]main game[/url]![/b]

Ignited Steel, will receive a[b] free update[/b] on Monday, and it will have a 25% discount during its first week!

New environments, new threats and new weapons to make an unique adventure through the universe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42526365/7296b5ec80a7b7b542e6d6d7f7cfb1bbbaf858d8.png[/img]
